title: Not because…, but because…
titleZh: 「Not because…, but because…」澄清真正原因
titleEn: Using Not because…, but because… to clarify the real reason

source.file: Sentence Structure 162 -「Not because…, but because…」澄清真正原因.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Subject + action / state + not because + rejected reason, but because + real reason

formulas.formula: Subject + action / state + not because + rejected reason, but because + real reason
Subject + do / does / did not + base verb + because + rejected reason, but because + real reason

example: People do not resist change because they are lazy, but because they are uncertain.
exampleZh: 人們抗拒改變，不是因為懶惰，而是因為感到不確定。

examples.en: People do not resist change because they are lazy, but because they are uncertain.
examples.zh: 人們抗拒改變，不是因為懶惰，而是因為感到不確定。
examples.highlight: People do not resist change because they are lazy, but because they are uncertain.

rules.zh: not 通常並非否定主要動作，而是否定第一個原因。 這句表示人們確實抗拒改變，只是「懶惰」並非真正原因。
rules.en: “Not” rejects the first reason. It does not normally deny that the main action happened; it denies only the first explanation. People resist change not because they are lazy, but because they are uncertain means that people do resist change, but laziness is not the real reason.
examples: People resist change not because they are lazy, but because they are uncertain.

rules.zh: because 後面通常要接完整子句，即主語加動詞。
rules.en: Use a complete clause after because Because should normally be followed by a subject and a verb. because not because the task was difficult not because she lacked experience Not used as the target structure in this exercise: not because of the difficult task not because of her lack of experience
examples: not because the task was difficult

rules.zh: 被否定的原因和真正原因必須解釋同一個動作、決定、感受或結果。
rules.en: Both reasons must explain the same action The rejected reason and the real reason must refer to the same event, decision, feeling or result.

rules.zh: 兩部分應保持平衡，not 和 but 後面都使用 because。
rules.en: Keep the two parts parallel Use because after both not and but. not because she was careless, but because she lacked information
examples: not because she was careless, but because she lacked information

rules.zh: 在書面英語中，通常在 but 前加逗號。
rules.en: Place a comma before but The meeting ended early not because everyone agreed, but because the building had to close.
examples: The meeting ended early not because everyone agreed, but because the building had to close.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚區分錯誤原因和真正原因，避免讀者誤解事情發生的原因。
benefits.en: It clearly separates a false reason from the real reason This structure prevents the reader from misunderstanding why something happened.

benefits.zh: 你不需要直接說別人的想法錯誤，而可以先提及對方可能想到的原因，再指出實際情況。
benefits.en: It helps you correct assumptions politely Instead of simply saying that another person is wrong, you can acknowledge the possible explanation and then provide the correct one.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以把三句較短和重複的句子合併成一句完整而流暢的句子。
benefits.en: It combines several short sentences into one Without the structure: Leo apologised. His manager did not force him. He knew he was wrong. With the structure: Leo apologised not because his manager forced him to, but because he knew he was wrong.

benefits.zh: 你可以比較兩個可能原因，而不只是提供一個簡單解釋，因此特別適合討論、作文、報告和簡報。
benefits.en: It makes explanations and arguments more precise You can compare two possible causes instead of giving only one simple reason. This is useful in discussions, essays, reports and presentations.

benefits.zh: 真正原因放在 but because 後面，通常會成為整句最突出、最容易被記住的部分。
benefits.en: It places emphasis on the real reason The true explanation appears after but because, so it becomes the final and most memorable part of the sentence.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

questions.prompt: Emma took an umbrella because rain was expected. The cold weather was not the reason.
questions.promptZh: 艾瑪帶了雨傘，因為預料會下雨。寒冷的天氣並不是原因。
questions.answer: Emma took an umbrella not because the weather was cold, but because rain was expected.
questions.answerZh: 艾瑪帶雨傘，不是因為天氣寒冷，而是因為預料會下雨。
questions.highlight: Emma took an umbrella not because the weather was cold, but because rain was expected.

questions.answerZh: 本提早離開派對，不是因為感到沉悶，而是因為身體不適。
questions.highlight: Ben left the party early not because he was bored, but because he felt unwell.

questions.highlight: Maya studied late not because her teacher told her to, but because she had a test the next morning.
